A. As per the terms of an order dated January 16, 2020 passed by the Hon’ble Bombay High Court (HC) (read with its modified order dated January 30, 2020) in I.A. No. 1 of 2020 in Petition No. 2972 of 2018, Mrs. Pooja Bajaj, acting in her capacity as the mother and natural guardian of her minor son Master Vanraj Bajaj, had submitted an undertaking to the HC that 1/3rd share, being the allocated share of Master Vanraj Bajaj, from and out of the estate of his deceased father Late Mr. Anant Bajaj (including 18,43,556 equity shares in the Company), shall be kept aside and not to be dealt with during the minority of Master Vanraj Bajaj, without the prior leave of the HC.

ii. The said non-disposal undertaking amounted to an encumbrance upon the said 18,43,556 equity shares in the Company (which was made effective/formalized by way of debit freeze on July 3, 2020).

iii. The said encumbrance was in terms of an order of HC and hence there is no pledge/encumbrance to that effect in the depository records. However, to maintain uniformity in disclosures at group level, the Bajaj Group Companies (including the Company) have decided to show the shareholding of Master Vanraj Bajaj as pledged / encumbered shares during his minority.

B. There are 57,14,850 total Employee Stock Options (ESOPS) granted under the two schemes viz. Bajel Projects Limited -Special Purpose ESOP Scheme 2023 ("ESOP 2023") and Bajel Projects Limited - Employee Stock Options Plan 2024 ("ESOP 2024").
1. Under “ESOP 2023”: As on date, a total of 2,57,000 ESOPs remain outstanding, comprising 2,25,000 ESOPs held by employees of Bajaj Electricals Limited (BEL) and 32,000 ESOPs held by employees of Bajel Projects Limited (BPL). Pursuant to the order dated June 8, 2023, passed by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, approving the demerger of BEL and the transfer of its Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) business to BPL, the ESOP entitlements of eligible employees were continued in accordance with the applicable terms of the Scheme. For the purpose of reporting, the ESOP holders who are employees of BEL, along with those who are employees of BPL, have been reflected under the “Employee” column.

2. Further, under ESOP 2024, a total of 32,75,444 options granted (vested/unvested) are outstanding, which includes options to KMPs and Directors of 9,63,000 ESOPs shares.
Accordingly, a total of 25,69,444 options are outstanding, which includes options granted under both the new and old ESOP schemes. These shares have been disclosed under the subgroup heading “Any other (Specify)”
